title: Dr. Iqbal Ahmad Kharal: Real-Time Patient Scheduling & Queue Management System
shortTitle: Dr. Iqbal Ahmad Kharal Booking System
formulaSummary: A real-time appointment booking and queue management system built with React, Node.js, and WhatsApp Cloud API for Dr. Iqbal Ahmad Kharal's specialist clinic, achieving a 42% decrease in waiting room congestion, zero double-booking incidents, and saving 25+ hours of front-desk scheduling work per week.

problem.heading: Waiting Room Congestion & Manual Reception Overload
problem.description: Handling up to 80 daily consultations through phone calls and physical reception desk registers created severe waiting room congestion. Patients frequently waited 2 to 3 hours past their estimated time. Double-bookings during surge hours frustrated patients, and clinic staff had no automated way to notify patients when appointments were delayed due to emergency procedures.
painPoints: Receptionists overwhelmed with non-stop phone calls coordinating daily consultation slots
Patients waiting 2 to 3 hours beyond their estimated appointment times
Paper registers causing accidental double-bookings during peak clinical hours
No automated notifications when emergency hospital surgeries delayed the clinic schedule

solution.heading: Atomic Slot Allocation & Real-Time Queue Monitoring
solution.description: Tech Agenz engineered a high-concurrency patient appointment booking platform. We implemented atomic slot reservation to eliminate double bookings, a mobile-first appointment booking interface requiring zero app installation, and automated WhatsApp/SMS webhooks that confirm booking details. The doctor's administrative dashboard gives immediate control over session capacity, emergency slot freezes, and real-time patient queue monitoring.
keyDeliverables: Mobile-first patient self-booking workflow with zero app download required
Atomic database slot reservation completely preventing conflicting bookings
Automated WhatsApp/SMS alerts for appointment confirmations and time reminders
Doctor and reception control dashboard for queue monitoring and emergency session freezes

architecture.overview: Patients reserve slots through a mobile-optimized portal or WhatsApp webhook. The system validates slot availability against PostgreSQL with atomic row-level locks, transmits instant confirmation alerts, and logs the patient into the clinic's real-time queue monitor.

flowSteps.title: Slot Selection
flowSteps.description: Patient selects available consultation slot from real-time calendar.

flowSteps.title: Atomic Lock & Reservation
flowSteps.description: Database enforces row-level locking to prevent concurrent booking conflicts.

flowSteps.title: Automated WhatsApp Confirmation
flowSteps.description: Instant booking confirmation and token number dispatched to patient's phone.

flowSteps.title: Live Queue Dashboard
flowSteps.description: Clinic receptionist tracks check-ins and physician views live consultation queue.

keyFeatures.title: Atomic Slot Reservation
keyFeatures.description: PostgreSQL row-level isolation preventing two patients from booking the same slot.

keyFeatures.title: Automated WhatsApp/SMS Alerts
keyFeatures.description: Immediate token confirmation, location directions, and 2-hour pre-visit reminders.

keyFeatures.title: Physician Control Console
keyFeatures.description: Real-time queue tracking, one-tap emergency freezes, and daily consultation counters.

keyFeatures.title: Mobile-First Patient UI
keyFeatures.description: Accessible to patients of all ages on any smartphone without downloading an app.
